resources.string: Blends the frames ahead of and behind the current one, like CC Wide Time in After Effects: trails and edit-style motion smear. Works on video, precomps and adjustment layers.
3D northern lights in a starry sky, reflected in water. Follows the composition camera. Curtains, colors, sky and quality are adjustable.
Sorts the pixels of each interval by brightness, hue, color or saturation, in the direction you choose: horizontal, vertical, diagonal, angle or radial.
